description: Database view exposing production stock request data.
business_purpose: Used to track and report production stock request records, including amounts and quantities, for the Factory & Inventory area.
record_granularity: One row represents one record returned by the production stock request view.

columns.name: headerId
columns.description: Header id of the production stock request.

columns.name: detailId
columns.description: Detail id of the production stock request.

columns.name: productid
columns.description: Productid of the production stock request.

columns.name: product_name_type
columns.description: Product name type of the production stock request.

columns.name: size
columns.description: Size of the production stock request.

columns.name: grade
columns.description: Grade of the production stock request.

columns.name: thickeness
columns.description: Thickeness of the production stock request.

columns.name: qty
columns.description: Qty of the production stock request.

columns.name: FullName
columns.description: Full name of the production stock request.

business_rules: production_date is the preferred date column for period-based reporting.
Use qty for monetary or quantity totals.
Columns product_name_type classify the record; check the distinct values before filtering on them.
Vw_ProductionStockRequest is a database view: it is read-only and its rows are computed, so apply filters and a LIMIT when querying.
common_queries: Production Stock Request count by product name type

known_issues: Views expose no primary key or nullability guarantees; rows may repeat depending on the view definition.

query_notes: The database is MySQL/MariaDB; use MySQL syntax and the exact name Vw_ProductionStockRequest (identifiers can be case-sensitive).
Use SUM(qty) for totals of qty.
This is a view; always apply filters and a LIMIT, as it may be expensive to scan.
